source: hg-engine 64838bf7db (0.8.5, kumakuma1/hardlove beta_hardlove; hacks/hardlove-gold/.src/repos/hardlove: data/Moves.c effect ids and effectChance, include/config.h GEN_LATEST 9, in-game move descriptions in Moves.c). The pinned repo has no battle effect code, so each override rests on the effect id, its effectChance and the description text.
notes: Smog: effectChance 100 with MOVE_EFFECT_POISON_HIT, so the poison is guaranteed (table: 40 %) (data/Moves.c:3337; Move Changes.xlsx: Effect chance 40 -> 100)
Rock Smash: effectChance 100 with MOVE_EFFECT_LOWER_DEFENSE_HIT, so the target's Defense -1 is guaranteed (table: 50 %) (data/Moves.c:6739; Move Changes.xlsx: Effect chance 50 -> 100)
Charge Beam: effectChance 100 with MOVE_EFFECT_RAISE_SP_ATK_HIT, so the user's Sp. Atk +1 is guaranteed (table: 70 %) (data/Moves.c:12193; Move Changes.xlsx: Effect chance 70 -> 100)

Diamond Storm (not overridden): effectChance 50 with MOVE_EFFECT_RAISE_DEF_2_HIT, so the user's Defense +2 is a 50 % chance (data/Moves.c:16054; in-game text: "This may also sharply boost the user's Defense stat."); the shared table agrees

Rapid Spin: MOVE_EFFECT_REMOVE_HAZARDS_AND_BINDING with no Speed effect and the in-game text names no Speed rise, so the user's Speed +1 (Gen 8+) is removed (data/Moves.c:6193; description at data/Moves.c:6211)

Growth: MOVE_EFFECT_SP_ATK_UP and the in-game text "It raises the Sp. Atk stat.": Sp. Atk +1 only, no Attack and no doubling in Sun (table: Atk +1 Sp. Atk +1, Sun x2) (data/Moves.c:2008; description at data/Moves.c:2024)

Thief: MOVE_EFFECT_HIT, and Move Changes.xlsx says "No longer steal items": no item steal (table: steal on hit). The in-game text (data/Moves.c:4540 description) still says it steals; the code and the sheet say no, so the steal is removed. Check on the Thor.

Covet: MOVE_EFFECT_HIT, same as Thief: no item steal (table: steal on hit) (data/Moves.c:9271; Move Changes.xlsx: No longer steal items). The in-game text still says it steals; the same conflict as Thief.

Scale Shot: MOVE_EFFECT_MULTI_HIT only. The in-game text says "This raises Speed but lowers Defense." (data/Moves.c:21658 description), so the table's user Def -1 Spe +1 is kept. No code in the pinned repo to confirm it.

Thrash, Petal Dance, Outrage, Raging Fury: MOVE_EFFECT_CONTINUE_AND_CONFUSE_SELF (the user is confused after the rampage). Confusion on the user is a volatile the calc does not model, so no override (data/Moves.c:1003).

Blockers: include/config.h sets GEN_LATEST 9 for the battle rules (TYPE_EFFECTIVENESS_GEN, Protean 9, Battle Bond, and the rest of the modern gates), so the table's Gen 9 blockers hold. Electric paralysis (Gen 6+), powder vs Grass / Overcoat / Safety Goggles (Gen 6+), Prankster vs Dark (Gen 7+), Misty Terrain confusion (Gen 7+): no hack-specific switch found, so no rules override. Not checked: the handlers themselves (not in the pinned repo subset). FOG_WEATHER_MISTY_TERRAIN is commented out (Fog does not set Misty Terrain).

Rapid Spin.n: hg-engine data/Moves.c:6193 REMOVE_HAZARDS_AND_BINDING, no Speed rise (table Spe +1)

Growth.n: hg-engine data/Moves.c:2008 SP_ATK_UP, in-game text: Sp. Atk only (table Atk +1 Sp. Atk +1, Sun x2)

unsourced: Scale Shot: the table's self effect kept on the in-game text alone (the pinned repo has no handler for MULTI_HIT)
Growth, Rapid Spin, Thief, Covet: the effect id and description are the only evidence, no battle code in the pinned repo subset
Thrash, Petal Dance, Outrage, Raging Fury: user confusion after the rampage is a volatile, not modelled (no override)
